quarterly_data.quarter: Siemens press release: Siemens will digitalize the 100 MW hydrogen plant in Sines, (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Siemens is deploying its Hydrogen Performance Suite (a physics-based digital process twin with real-time optimization) and wider hydrogen software portfolio for the 100 MW first phase of Galp Energia's GalpH2Park in Sines, Portugal, which starts operating at year-end and is set to produce up to 15,000 tons of renewable hydrogen per year; Siemens estimates the suite can deliver energy savings of up to 15 percent.
quarterly_data.figure: 100 MW plant; up to 15,000 tons of hydrogen a year
